instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot. Inside a white-walled studio with a red carpet, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left, balancing on her left leg as she kicks her right leg forward. On the right, the bearded man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing her, watching the kick. The room is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent fixtures, casting soft shadows on the red carpet. The background features studio equipment and white walls.
